title: Unit Event — The Legend Still Vivid — Episode6 What I Can Still Remember

meta.Episode: Episode6 — What I Can Still Remember
meta.Event Outline: Thanks to their experience of going camping together, VBS has learned the importance of having a shared vision when they sing. Kohane asks Taiga if there's a way for them to establish a shared vision of RAD WEEKEND without any footage of the event to go off of.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yup! Wait, where is everyone...?
Did we not get any customers today?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: A big group was here for a bit after an event had got out and left just a little while ago. This might be it for the bar tonight.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What? You're calling it quits while a woman in her eighties is still working herself to the bone?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, I was acting as their guide today.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Haha. Is that so?
By the way, how was our dear, old owner?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Good. Honestly, I'm having a hard time seeing her lose to Father Time at this point...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But I think it was worth the trip. It looked like they managed to figure out something.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a slightly better idea of what happened during RAD WEEKEND because of what you did for us.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You think so?
In that case, you're welcome.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (I've seen this look on Taiga's face before.)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Relax, will you?
The stage isn't going anywhere.

All I want to do right now is sing.
So hurry!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Alright, I get it. Be right there...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (This has to be why he was willing to show them COL.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Maybe not consciously, but if Taiga's going to make a move like that...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (It's time for me to act as well.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's about time you guys saw this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mind if we have a look at it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's something written on the cover... “RAD WEEKEND”...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Yes.
It's a video of RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad, you said there weren't any videos of what happened...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I was asked to hold on to this one and forgot about it.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hold on to it?
What are you talking about, Ken?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
No cameras were allowed. Period.
Granny even agreed to those terms.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: She's the one who took this.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, this'll show you what happened during RAD WEEKEND from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We have a screen and projector for the stage area, so I'll go get those set up!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You two get the projector set up.
We'll unfurl the screen while you do.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Why'd Granny take this?
She's the owner. She's supposed to enforce these kinds of rules.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: She said Nagi asked her to do this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Excuse me, can you tell me where the DVD player is...? Oh...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Nagi apparently said, “This will help someone down the road, so please record it for us in secret.”

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: However, you were gone before she even had a chance to tell you about this...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Nagi Kotaki. She's Uncle Taiga's little sister.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She, Uncle Taiga and Dad used to be on the same team.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: As you know, I've been wanting to learn more about what happened during RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I'd really like it if you could give Nagi my regards as well!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Alright...
I'll tell her the next time I see her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you find us a DVD player yet?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, right...!
Do you have one we can borrow?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi, the screen's all set up.
